Columbus

Harris County

I also serve Harris County. Share your property requirements or the location of the home or land you want to sell. For a parcel-specific conversation, visit land and acreage.

Alabama service areas

Phenix City

I work with buyers and sellers in Phenix City. Tell me about the property you own or the purchase you have in mind. If you are considering a newly built home, explore new-construction representation.

Smiths Station

Auburn and Opelika

I also assist clients in Auburn and Opelika. Tell me which location and type of property you want to discuss, including a purchase, sale or investment.

Your questions, answered

Have a question about your own situation? April answers personally.

Ask April
Which Georgia areas does April Johnson serve?

My Georgia service areas include Columbus and Harris County, along with other locations within my licensed service markets. Send the property location to discuss your needs.

Which Alabama areas does April Johnson serve?

My Alabama service areas include Phenix City, Smiths Station, Auburn and Opelika, along with other locations within my licensed service markets.

Can April help me compare locations in Alabama and Georgia?

Yes. I am licensed in both states. Tell me which areas, property features and destinations you want to consider.

How do I choose an area for my home search?

Start with your budget questions, property requirements and the places you need to reach. Discuss current, address-specific information before relying on a general description.

Does April serve areas surrounding Fort Benning?

Yes. I assist with purchases and sales connected to relocations to or from Fort Benning and surrounding communities.
